PORTRAIT: See the asset registry note for hana: image 3: pencil in her teeth, notebook clutched to her chest. Character-portrait template, --ar 2:3, stylize 200, gouache and watercolour anime illustration on a flat teal-grey wall, warm orange golden-hour light across the face.

VOICE NOTES: forced catchphrases in this regular's tics and sample lines were rewritten as habits and manner (tools/art-review/ledger.json has each before and after).

Her or his real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file (Proposed: level 1, a candidate, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists.); not carried here.
